Function Name: matrix_operations  
Description: Performs basic matrix multiplication of two 2D arrays (matrices) and stores each result in a global cache called `computation_cache`. If the same pair of matrices is multiplied again, the cached result is returned instead of recomputing.  
Parameters:  
• matrix_a (list of lists of numbers): The first matrix, dimensions m×n.  
• matrix_b (list of lists of numbers): The second matrix, dimensions n×p.  

Example:  
```python
# Initial global cache
computation_cache = {}

# Call the function
result = matrix_operations(
    [[1, 2],
     [3, 4]],
    [[5, 6],
     [7, 8]]
)

print(result)            # Outputs: [[19, 22], [43, 50]]
print(computation_cache) # {
                        #   ("[[1, 2], [3, 4]]", "[[5, 6], [7, 8]]"):
                        #       [[19, 22], [43, 50]]
                        # }
```
